More than just a shopping experience, the Millen Produce Market is a gathering place. It’s where neighbors meet, visitors discover the charm of our town, and everyone comes together to celebrate local flavors and talents. Every purchase supports small farms, family businesses, and artisans right here in Jenkins County, helping keep our community strong and thriving. Whether you’re stocking up on vegetables for the week, picking out something sweet for dessert, or grabbing a bag of boiled peanuts to snack on, the Millen Produce Market offers something for everyone. Fresh, local, and full of heart—this is Millen at its best.

The LaFayette Farmers Market season runs every Saturday from late April through August, bringing together local farmers, bakers, artisans, food vendors, musicians, and community organizations. Each market features fresh locally grown food, handcrafted goods, live music, free family activities, and educational classes. Serving more than 1,000 visitors each Saturday, the market provides a vibrant community gathering space while supporting local agriculture, small businesses, and economic growth throughout Northwest Georgia.

season: Throughout the season, the Hall County Farmers Market brings together local farmers, food producers, and artisans offering fresh, in-season produce, farm-fresh eggs, beef, pork, baked goods, microgreens, flowers, jams and jellies, handcrafted soaps, woodworking, birdhouses, pet treats, and other locally made products. In partnership with the UGA Extension Office, visitors can receive gardening advice from Certified Master Gardeners, learn about canning and food preservation, pick up recipes and free seeds, and enjoy educational demonstrations throughout the season. The Hall County Recycling Center also partners with HCFM to provide recycling and sustainability resources, helping encourage environmentally responsible practices within our community.
